name: grep
description: Search the working tree for a regex with ripgrep (respects .gitignore). Results are file:line:text; lines longer than 300 characters are cut.

glob.description: Restrict the search to paths matching this glob, e.g. `*.rs`.

path.description: File or directory to search, relative to the workspace root. Defaults to the whole tree.

context.description: Lines of context to show around each match (at most 10).

files_only.description: List only the paths of matching files.
